unchanged.capacity: Use current gameplay units, never recompute from new cavity area.

dynamic_rule: Clip gravity-oriented liquid using the new full cavity. Preserve existing volume; only emit a stream when liquid actually intersects a wetted outlet. resting_rule: Keep old upright visual mapping and shoulder full level; retain static mask for resting rendering or use strict old fill mapping with the new cavity. Never flood-fill the new neck at rest, rotate a fixed liquid sticker or raise upright level to hide a dynamic-flow bug.
